channel.description: Latest articles from Prince George Citizen (princegeorgecitizen.com)

item.title: Investigators to probe derailment on CN line in central Alberta: TSB
item.description: EDMONTON — The Transportation Safety Board says it's sending a team of investigators to Alberta after 37 train cars went off the tracks west of Edmonton.

item.title: The Mavs are leaving no doubt that Cooper Flagg is their future after trading Anthony Davis
item.description: DALLAS (AP) — Cooper Flagg is in the midst of an unprecedented run for an NBA teenager just as the Dallas Mavericks are firmly declaring their rookie No. 1 pick the future face of the franchise. The day was coming regardless.

item.title: Timberwolves acquire Ayo Dosunmu for scoring depth in trade-deadline deal with Bulls
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS (AP) — The Minnesota Timberwolves acquired guard Ayo Dosunmu from the Chicago Bulls on Thursday, adding a proven scorer to bolster their depth for the stretch run in the stacked Western Conference playoffs race.

item.title: Austin Reaves scores 35, Lakers overcome Luka's injury departure for 119-115 win over Sixers
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Austin Reaves scored 35 points in just 25 minutes, and the Los Angeles Lakers overcame Luka Doncic’s departure with a left leg injury for a 119-115 victory over the Philadelphia 76ers on Thursday night.

item.title: Golden Knights dominate Kings 4-1 with early scoring blitz
item.description: LAS VEGAS (AP) — Mark Stone had a goal and two assists and the Vegas Golden Knights took control early Thursday night by scoring four times on their first six shots for a 4-1 victory over the Los Angeles Kings.

item.title: Warriors erase 14-point deficit in the fourth quarter to beat the Suns 101-97
item.description: PHOENIX (AP) — Pat Spencer scored a career-high 20 points, Gui Santos added 18 and the shorthanded Golden State Warriors erased a 14-point deficit in the fourth quarter to beat the Phoenix Suns 101-97 on Thursday night.

item.title: Hornets beat Rockets 109-99 for eighth straight win
item.description: HOUSTON (AP) — Rookie Kon Knueppel had 24 points and LaMelo Ball added 20 to help the Charlotte Hornets roll to a 109-99 victory over the Houston Rockets on Thursday night and extend their winning streak to eight games.

item.title: Lightning beat Panthers 6-1 before Olympic break
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. (AP) — Andrei Vasilevskiy stopped 33 shots to improve to 16-0-1 in his past 17 games, helping the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Florida Panthers 6-1 on Thursday night in the final game for both teams before the Olympic break.

item.title: Mountie says video was on phones of B.C. couple found dead in bed with two sons
item.description: A British Columbia couple made a video "last will and testament" three days before they were found dead in bed with the bodies of their two young sons, teddy bears at the children's feet, a coroner's inquest has heard. RCMP Corp.
